text: גם יקר לי שם וגם בא לי יותר בר מאשר מסעדה
why: One sentence can carry two fields. Extracting one of them would leave half an objection on the table.

text: סתם לא מתחשק לי, אין סיבה מיוחדת
why: Nothing maps to the vocabulary, and nothing points at the venue either. A field invented here would change the next ranking on an opinion nobody stated (#86), and 'none' is what lets A8 say so instead. The first version of this text said "לא בא לי שם" and expected 'none'; the model answered 'venue_identity' three times out of three, and it was right — "שם" points at the place. The fixture said one thing and meant another, which is the #86 category, so the text was fixed rather than the expectation.

text: רחוק לי מדי, אין לי דרך להגיע עד לשם
why: Too far, with no number: a direction, which code turns into a tolerance from the rejected venue (#220). The model never picks the number.

text: מאוחר מדי בשבילי, אני לא יכול לצאת בשעה כזאת
why: Too late, with no time: a direction, which code turns into a latest start half an hour before the rejected one (#220).

text: היה לי שם פעם מקרה לא נעים, כל מקום אחר בסדר מבחינתי
why: The objection is to that place, not to any quality of it. A8b blocks the pair; there is nothing to correct.

text: האמת שדווקא בא לי סושי הערב, לא את אותו הדבר כרגיל
why: Stated as a wish rather than a complaint. It is still exactly one field, and reading it as 'none' would drop what the person actually said.

text: רק לא אוכל אסייתי בבקשה, אכלתי כזה אתמול
why: What someone does not want is as actionable as what they want, and a different field (#220).

text: אני יכולה להגיע רק אחרי שמונה
why: A time the person wrote is taken as written, not turned into a direction (#220).

text: זה רחוק מדי, אני לא מוכן לנסוע יותר משני קילומטר
why: A distance the person wrote wins over 'closer'; one fact, not two (#220).

text: גם רחוק לי וגם הייתי מעדיפה בר ולא מסעדה
why: One rejection, several facts. Asking for a single label made the model drop all but one; now each lands in its field (#220).

text: אין שם איפה להחנות, אני מגיע ברכב
why: Nothing the weighing can act on — but it is set aside as untranslated, so the missing lever (parking) can be counted (#220).
